[Related services and information](https://www.wa.gov.au/service/employment/workplace-arrangements/public-holidays-western-australia#rel-services-01) Contents1 - Public holidays in Western Australia - 2026 to 20272 - Regional King’s Birthday public holiday3 - Pay rates and entitlements for public holidays4 - Previous years public holiday dates5 - Previous years regional King’s Birthday public holiday dates6 - Related services and information ## Public holidays in Western Australia - 2026 to 2027 [School term and school holiday dates for WA are on the Department of Education website](http://www.education.wa.edu.au/) | | 2026 | 2027 | | --- | --- | --- | | New Year's Day | Thursday 1 January | Friday 1 January | | Australia Day | Monday 26 January | Tuesday 26 January | | Labour Day | Monday 2 March | Monday 1 March | | Good Friday | Friday 3 April | Friday 26 March | | Easter Sunday | Sunday 5 April | Sunday 28 March | | Easter Monday | Monday 6 April | Monday 29 March | | Anzac Day | Saturday 25 April

Tuesday 28 December | - When New Year’s Day, Anzac Day, or Christmas Day falls on a Saturday or Sunday the next following Monday is also a public holiday. - When 26 January (Australia Day) falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the first Monday following 26 January is the public holiday. - When Boxing Day falls on a Saturday the next following Monday is also a public holiday, and when Boxing Day falls on a Sunday or Monday the next following Tuesday is also a public holiday. [Printable version of public holiday dates in WA 2026-2027 (PDF, 141.56 KB)](https://www.wa.gov.au/media/151671/download?inline "Public holidays in WA 2026-2027") ## Regional King’s Birthday public holiday Some regional areas in Western Australia hold the King's Birthday public holiday on an alternative date, usually to coincide with a significant date or event for that area. | 2026 Regional WA public holiday dates | | --- | | Local Government Authority | Public holiday dates | Area affected | | --- | --- | --- | | City of Karratha | Monday 3 August | Karratha local government district. | | Town of Port Hedland | Monday 3 August | Port Hedland local government district. | In these regional areas, the alternative King’s Birthday public holiday is observed **instead of** the King’s Birthday public holiday observed in the rest of WA. The date on which the King’s Birthday public holiday is observed in the rest of Western Australia is not a public holiday in these regions. ## Pay rates and entitlements for public holidays [Show more](https://www.wa.gov.au/service/employment/workplace-arrangements/public-holidays-western-australia# "View details for Pay rates and entitlements for public holidays") Two systems of employment law operate for the private sector in Western Australia, the state industrial relations system and the national fair work system. Visit [Which system of employment law applies](https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/private-sector-labour-relations/which-system-of-employment-law-applies "") for more information. Pay rates and employment entitlements for public holidays are based on which system covers a particular employee, the employee’s award or agreement coverage, and whether they are full time, part time or casual. National system employers and employees should visit the [Fair Work Ombudsman](http://www.fairwork.gov.au/) or call 13 13 94. State system employers and employees should visit [Public holiday pay and arrangements](https://www.wa.gov.au/organisation/private-sector-labour-relations/public-holiday-pay-and-entitlements-state-system-employees "Public holiday pay and entitlements for state system employees"). ## Previous years public holiday dates [Show more](https://www.wa.gov.au/service/employment/workplace-arrangements/public-holidays-western-australia# "View details for Previous years public holiday dates") | | Public holiday dates 2021 - 2025 | | --- | --- | | 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | New Year's Day | Friday
